title: 1995 AMC 8 Problem 6
statement: Figures \(I,\) \(II\) and \(III\) are squares. The perimeter of \(I\) is \(12\) and the perimeter of \(II\) is \(24.\) The perimeter of \(III\) is

solutions.text:
Square \(I\) has side \(12 \div 4 = 3,\) and square \(II\) has side \(24 \div 4 = 6.\)

From the figure, the side of \(III\) is \(3 + 6 = 9,\) so its perimeter is \(4 \times 9 = 36.\)

Thus, the correct answer is C .
hints: The perimeter of a square is \(4\) times its side, so find the side of \(I\) and of \(II\)
From the figure, the side of \(III\) equals the side of \(I\) plus the side of \(II\)
